findings.approved_contract: DX1 pure_C_contract.order/requirements requires the actual missing completeness, requirement and approval decisions to be reported, sorted and deduplicated. M02-T02/T03 explicitly require missing decision/approval explanation.
findings.observed: missing() checks only nonempty + sorted unique. save_only! discards returned fields. Except one topology scenario, no assertion binds the missing list to the deliberately missing field or verifies that confirmed fields are not falsely reported.
findings.counterexample: A missing-decision response containing only [topology] satisfies the helper for missing acceptance, tentative requirements, empty toolchain and absent verified approval even when topology is confirmed. This is an assertion-logic counterexample, not an executed product mutation.
findings.impact: A future implementation may pass these cases while reporting incorrect decisions; the 65-marker RED count cannot establish a complete behavioral oracle.
findings.required_correction: Strengthen existing cases to assert each approved missing cause (and combined sorted/deduplicated completeness), including approval-specific reason. Preserve all existing cases and behavioral intent. Record field-path spelling using existing M01 FieldPath vocabulary; do not invent approval authentication in WORK.

findings.counterexample: A future policy that returns SaveDefinitionOnly immediately whenever approval/topology is missing, without validating malicious artifact paths or duplicate identities, is not rejected by these existing 65 cases.
findings.required_correction: Add mixed cases for unsafe artifact path + missing approval, invalid project identity + missing topology, and duplicate target identity + incomplete requirement. Assert the existing typed structural rejection takes precedence; no IO or new error variant required.
